properties.description: `docker/smoke.sh`, run by release.yml against the candidate image BEFORE the push. Starts the container on a uid-1000 volume, refuses immediately if the process exited (the failure this exists for is an instant exit, and waiting on a health probe would report it as a timeout instead of naming the cause), then waits on the image's OWN HEALTHCHECK, then makes one request from OUTSIDE the container — because an in-container probe cannot catch a bind to loopback. DEMONSTRATED 2026-08-15 both ways on a locally built image: PASSES in ~8s on the fixed Dockerfile, and FAILS in ~3s on a Dockerfile with the pre-v0.27.0 `--content-path` restored, printing `error: unexpected argument '--content-path' found` and exit 2. SCOPE, stated so this is not read as more than it is: it has not yet run in CI, and it proves the image SERVES, not that any tool behaves correctly.
properties.name: The published image starts, reports healthy, and answers on its port
